interstitial.why: No AglAds.onTransition() in mobile/lib (grep: none); the per-tab interstitial was removed per spec (HomeWise.md:239). Keep it absent: a mortgage/affordability calculator in a finance context with short, task-focused sessions.

native.why: Finance context. The Homes list is the user's own saved homes with budget verdicts (sensitive financial data), and the code comment already rules out ads between homes (homes_screen.dart:132-135 'never between homes'). The Schedule is an amortization data table (schedule_screen.dart:178-181, _MonthTable at :179), not a feed. No browse/discovery list exists, so native = no.
